title: Freelancer or consultant
summary: A focused service profile: who you help, selected case studies, comparable offers and a clear first conversation.

for: Freelance designers, developers, writers and marketers
notFor: Agencies with a team page to show (start from small-business)

cards.purpose: State the specialty, intended client and useful result before asking for a call.
A clear way to discuss a potential project.
Selected case studies with the freelancer’s contribution and an approved result.
Up to four comparable offers, with format and published pricing when relevant.
Optional approved client words; never retain the demonstration quotes.
Professional profiles and a longer work or writing archive.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: Who is this page for, what do you make or offer, and what should a new visitor understand first?
slots.write: Use a short descriptive heading and two sentences: identify the person or group, the work and the audience. The header shows only the name; this card must explain the purpose. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: How should a new client start: a booking link for an intro call, email, or both?
slots.write: The first button is the booking link (book-call preset) when they have one. Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Are there case studies or projects you can link to?
slots.write: tag = client, only if publicly named with approval; title = the project or result; description = their contribution and a confirmed outcome. Feature up to four, linking to a complete portfolio for the rest. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What do you offer? For each: a name, how long or how often, a starting price if you publish one, and one line on the outcome.
slots.write: tag = format · price, only if they publish prices; title = the service name; description = the outcome for the client, not the activity. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you have two or three short client quotes you have permission to publish?
slots.write: Each quote verbatim, with name and role as the client approved. Never write or polish a quote. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which professional profiles or newsletter should be linked?
slots.write: Account URLs only; a label and description only for their own pages. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
